title: Astral Terraces
game_overview: Explore serene floating islands by rotating bridges, triggering switches, and aligning impossible pathways in an isometric 3D puzzle adventure.
winning_condition: Complete all ten handcrafted celestial architectural worlds by guiding Pip to each Sanctuary Shrine while optionally discovering Star Relics.
losing_condition: None in peaceful exploration; players can reset a puzzle state at any moment if they wish to rethink a configuration.

controls.input: W/A/S/D, Arrow Keys, Virtual D-Pad, or Tap/Click Tile
controls.action: Move Pip smoothly across connected walkways, stairs, rotating platforms, and aligned optical seams.

controls.input: Drag Background / Q & R / Orbit Buttons
controls.action: Smoothly orbit the isometric world by touch/mouse drag to inspect architecture and snap into 90-degree optical alignments.

controls.input: Tap or Drag Peach Cranks / E / ACT
controls.action: Directly turn astrolabe bridges without spinning the camera, or activate lift crystals.

sections.title: Design Pillars
sections.content: 1. Celestial Architectural Dreamworld: Muted turquoise, sage green, soft lavender, warm ivory, dusty rose, muted coral, pale gold, and deep indigo unify ten distinct floating sanctuaries. 2. Playable Optical Geometry: True orthographic isometric camera aligns separated elevations edge-to-edge along the exact sightline when rotated into alignment. 3. Local Browser Persistence: Structured localStorage saves track the player's local profile, unlocked levels, collected Star Relics, mid-level checkpoints, mechanism states, and settings without any login or external server.
sections.summary: Celestial architectural dreamworld, orthographic perspective illusions, and browser-local persistence.

sections.title: Structural Integrity
sections.content: Main Menu (Play/Continue, Level Select, Local Player Profile with editable display name, How to Play, Settings, New Game confirmation) -> 10-World Campaign with automatic discrete checkpoint & relic saving -> In-Game HUD & Pause Menu -> World Complete & Grand Convergence Victory.
sections.summary: Main menu with live diorama backdrop, 10-world selection screen, Local Player Profile, Settings, Guide, and localStorage persistence.
